svg.title: One Pulumi project deployed as two stacks
svg.desc: One Pulumi project, with one Python program, is deployed as two stacks. The dev stack reads Pulumi.dev.yaml, where versioning is false, and creates a private S3 bucket with public access blocked. The prod stack reads Pulumi.prod.yaml, where versioning is true, and creates its own private bucket with versioning enabled. Each stack keeps its own state in the backend.
